description: The Finnish Meteorological Institute provides hourly reference-weather scenarios for building-energy calculations under future Finnish climate conditions. TRY2030, TRY2050 and TRY2100 modify the TRY2012 reference year using climate-model mean changes under the SRES A2 emissions scenario. Public provider pages offer PRN text and PDF files for four Finnish temperature zones, with zones I and II sharing the Vantaa-based series. The describing article identifies temperature, humidity, wind and solar-radiation inputs for heating and cooling simulations. Files are available without a stated download fee. Website terms permit attributed private, non-commercial, teaching and research use, while wider redistribution requires permission; a separate open-data licence was not established for these legacy files. These are constructed reference years, not observations from the named future years. The producer warns of climate-model uncertainty and limits in representing extreme temperatures. A reviewer-assessed use is testing climate sensitivity of Finnish building-energy demand. model-energyplus is a related simulator; file conversion and direct compatibility were not tested. No weather file or PDF was downloaded.
